verdict.rationale: Push-based sign-in with phishing defenses is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only TOTP/HOTP code generation via QR or setup keys, plus sync, backups, sharing and lock screens. Nothing shows push approvals, number matching, location context or admin-enforced MFA policies.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
